title: Eager-closure budget: raise every byte ceiling by 20% on the maintainer's ruling, and move the regression the gate must catch with it
body:
Filing gate ③: a task the maintainer directed. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 4 (`session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`) on the maintainer's words in that session's chat, verbatim: 「上限同统一调高 20% ，避免类似的问题。」 (2026-10-16, about 11:00Z, answering objectstack-ai/objectui#12648's `vendor-objectstack` overrun).

## Why

`scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` sat with almost no headroom on `main` `8a8bcf3d`:
- `vendor-objectstack`: 1,536,365 measured against 1,536,409, a headroom of 44 gzipped bytes;
- the aggregate: 3,114.8 KB against 3,119.4 KB.

So every `@objectstack/*` bump reds `Bundle Analysis` and needs a measured raise round. objectstack-ai/objectui#12648 (the `next.2` bump) spent a round on exactly that. The ruling is to give every ceiling 20% room, so that a bump of normal size passes.

## Target

1. **Every byte ceiling in `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` × 1.20,** rounded up to the nearest 1,000 bytes:
   - `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES`;
   - each entry of `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS` (`vendor-objectstack`, `ui-components`, `framework`, `i18n-locale-en`, and any other row).

   Take each value as it stands on `main` once objectstack-ai/objectui#12648 has merged; that PR raises `vendor-objectstack` by its measured +19,296 first.
2. **`REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES` moves too, or the gate reds itself.**
   - The ceiling-sensitivity half (`evaluateHeadroomSensitivity`) fails any ceiling whose headroom is at least that regression ("blind").
   - Today it is 89 KiB. A 20% raise leaves roughly 640 KB of headroom on the aggregate and roughly 290 KB on `vendor-objectstack`.
   - Set it to the smallest round value that keeps every ceiling non-blind on the measured build. Say in the docblock that the gate now catches only regressions of that size and above. That is the trade the ruling accepts.
   - The unit test's constant-vs-constant guard moves with it.
3. **Measurements are not ceilings.** `BASELINE` and `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` stay what was measured. Nothing is made lazy and no exemption is added. The entry-chunk budget (350 KB in the workflow) is far from its limit and is not part of this card.
4. **A dated docblock paragraph** in the file's precedent shape: the maintainer's words, the before and after table for every constant, and what the gate no longer catches.

## Acceptance

- `pnpm check:eager-closure` exits 0 on a fresh console build of the PR head.
- `scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts` passes.
- `Bundle Analysis` is green on the PR.
- The PR body carries the table.

## Constraints

- Lands after objectstack-ai/objectui#12648 (same file, same constant).
- No other gate changes.
